tasks.short: Escort mourners to the correct service room

steps.what: Check the current service schedule for the correct parlor or chapel
inputs: current funeral service schedule and room allocation

steps.what: Direct or escort mourners to the parlor or chapel in which the wake or funeral is being held
outputs: mourners directed or escorted to the service

tasks.design: Keep the native service schedule in {OPS_SYSTEM} and the attendant's personal guidance. The room lookup is already a short native view; no reduction of that lookup or the escort is established.
tasks.previous_blocker: Mourners may need personal assistance despite knowing the room name.
tasks.enabler_now: The existing service schedule supplies the room allocation.
tasks.still_hard: Recognize confusion or distress and respond respectfully.
tasks.human_edge: Offer calm, discreet assistance during a difficult occasion.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: a service schedule supplies room information but does not replace personal assistance to mourners.

assumptions: OPS_SYSTEM is the funeral service-management system. Boundary includes room lookup and actual direction or escort. No record write, report or independent send is specified.
The funeral coordinator supplies service ID, time and room in the existing schedule. A missing allocation requires manual clarification; no free new data capture is assumed.
Native schedule view checked first and already assumed sufficient. Shares are illustrative rather than measured. No introduced change means no upkeep.
unknowns: Whether the existing room schedule is readily accessible
research_questions: Does actual escort work contain a separately timed record action beyond checking the service room?

incremental.description: No new tool or record work

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Both the explicit room lookup and actual mourner assistance are fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Supervise the procession and cemetery parking

steps.what: Supervise the actual funeral procession and coordinate participants' movement
Assist mourners and drivers with actual cemetery parking conditions
inputs: actual cemetery parking and access conditions

tasks.design: Keep procession supervision and parking assistance with the attendant. A route reference in {DOCS} cannot remove the need to respond to actual vehicles, access and mourners.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual procession and parking conditions change during the service.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing route references support preparation without performing supervision.
tasks.still_hard: Respond to an unexpected obstruction without disrupting the occasion.
tasks.human_edge: Guide people calmly in the real setting.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: procession supervision and parking assistance require attention to actual people and vehicles.

assumptions: Boundary covers the actual procession and cemetery parking. The statement establishes no separate transport booking, incident report or send; none is assigned baseline time.
Inputs are existing arrangements and actual conditions; no new structured record is required. Native route references do not change the live work.
Shares are an illustrative split with no claimed time reduction. No change means zero upkeep.
unknowns: Whether local duties also include a separate route or vehicle record
research_questions: Observe whether any actual record action occurs separately from procession supervision.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Both physical supervision and actual parking assistance remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Select and physically issue the funeral equipment required for the service
Return and store funeral equipment in its appropriate storage location

tasks.design: Keep physical equipment issue and storage with the attendant. An inventory form in {OPS_SYSTEM} would change a distinct tracking action if one exists, but this statement does not establish that administrative workload.
tasks.previous_blocker: Equipment must be physically handled and put in the correct place.
tasks.enabler_now: Inventory software can track items without moving or storing them.
tasks.still_hard: Handle equipment carefully in the service environment.
tasks.human_edge: Notice condition or readiness problems while handling the item.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: an inventory record does not perform the physical issue and storage of funeral equipment.

assumptions: Boundary is equipment issue and storage. Before declaring zero, considered a checkout record: no such record is established by the statement, so no invented log baseline is added.
Inputs are actual equipment, existing service requirements and storage locations. Native inventory tracking cannot remove this handling and no new capture is introduced.
The issue/storage split is illustrative and both remain retained; no tool change means zero upkeep.
unknowns: Whether the organization actually keeps a separately timed equipment checkout or return record
research_questions: Observe equipment issue and split an actual checkout or return entry if present, then test native inventory fields.

incremental.description: No new inventory recording or software

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Physical issue and storage are fully retained; a separate log is not established.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Explain the family's chosen memorial donation route

steps.what: Read the family's approved memorial charity choice in the funeral file
inputs: family-approved charity choice in the existing service file

steps.what: Find and verify the chosen charity's actual donation instructions and memorial reference requirements
outputs: verified donation route and memorial reference

steps.what: Provide advice to mourners on how to make charitable donations in honor of the deceased and clarify their questions
inputs: verified donation route and memorial reference
outputs: mourners informed about the verified donation route

tasks.design: Link the family-approved charity choice in {OPS_SYSTEM} to the charity's own donation information in a reference view {OTHER}. The attendant verifies the route and explains it personally; no donation, payment link publication or tax advice is automated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeatedly finding the correct donation page can interrupt advice.
tasks.enabler_now: A native saved reference can bring the chosen charity's instructions directly into view.
tasks.still_hard: A wrong charity or reference would misdirect a mourner's intended gift.
tasks.human_edge: Respond sensitively and clarify the family's actual wishes.

ambition.what: No additional donation service or financial authority granted.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-4; service-file access and family preference handling

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: saved references can assist retrieval of a named charity's donation instructions; verification and personal explanation remain necessary.

assumptions: OPS_SYSTEM is funeral service management; OTHER is the charity donation-information reference view. Boundary covers lookup and verbal advice, not making donations, printing cards, publishing notices or sending messages.

The funeral coordinator records the family's actual approved charity choice in the existing service file. The charity owns its donation instructions and reference requirements; missing or conflicting details stop specific advice pending manual verification within s2.
Native saved references first. No invented financial account, tax rule or preapproved link is supplied. No new family-preference capture is assumed free.
Shares and lookup reduction are provisional. Gross 5 minus 0.5 upkeep gives 4.5 net; actual explanation and verification remain counted.
unknowns: Whether the approved charity choice and reliable donation instructions are readily available
research_questions: Does a saved charity reference reduce lookup without increasing stale or wrong donation information?

already_counted.description: Verify the current donation route before advising

incremental.description: Check saved charity references for changes

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero if instructions are already directly available; up to 3% when lookup gains are smaller than central 4.5% net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Mourner support and physical service work remain with the attendant; native lookups assist only verified information retrieval.
skills_to_grow: Verify the family's chosen donation route
Recognize information that needs clarification rather than guessing
role.ambitious_version: Calm personal assistance supported by accurate service and charity information.
